notes.title: ver1.0.1 defect information
notes.content:
The following bugs have been found in ver1.0.1, but they are not fatal bugs and will be treated as specifications.

Even if "Weight at end of turn" is changed to "Active" in the configuration battle settings, the game pauses after the end of the action.
When clearing stage 4, the achievement of clearing stage 5 is also achieved in addition to clearing stage 4.

notes.title: Product version ver1.0.1 and trial version ver0.0.6 are now available.
notes.content:
Product version ver1.0.1 and trial version ver0.0.6 are now available.

Fixed contents
Fixed a bug that caused the game to lose progress when the Help command was selected immediately after the Help command was opened from the menu screen in Act 1.
Fixed a bug that caused players to lose progress when they ran out of time on a 3-choice quiz question in Act 9.
Fixed a bug in which the experience of passive skills would be added when the "Wait until next action" or "Do nothing" command was selected when a passive skill was equipped in the first or second slot from the top.
Fixed an issue where if you saved and loaded the game immediately after defeating an enemy in a challenge battle where the victory condition was to "bring all enemies to the brink of death," the battle would restart from the middle instead of returning to the challenge screen.
Fixed a bug that caused the "undefinedundefined" screen to appear at the end of some events, making it impossible to progress.
Fixed an issue where the magic description field would be blank when Attack Strange was at level 3.
Fixed an issue where some events were not displayed properly.

Main changes
The condition under which enemies are registered in Library>Enemy on the menu screen has been changed from "Defeated at the time of battle victory" to "Encountered by the time of battle victory.

Translated with www.DeepL.com/Translator (free version)

notes.title: Re:Kuroi 配信開始！
notes.content:
The game is available from January 7, 2022 (Japan time).
The launch price is 10% off for the first week.
Don't miss out on this opportunity!

[previewyoutube=Rc-5lemJAqQ;full][/previewyoutube]
[Story]
This is a tale of wizards fighting against monsters that have suddenly begun to appear.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40127500/709d7326606eea0c466fc42c7ab51a998f38cf1e.png[/img]

Kaito, a young, bullied boy, meets wizards of different professions: a parttime teacher, a waitress, a retired soldier, and a suspicious dealer of information. What lies ahead for them as their different ways of thinking, emotions, and lifestyles come together?

[Game Features]
-Turned-Based RPG

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40127500/f09ff8ccf382ace1edf008d4dab5353f690c8112.png[/img]

Battles combine real time and turn-based combat.
Time your blocks correctly to defend against enemy attacks!
Read your enemies’ actions and seize victory!

-Magic System

Become stronger the more you use magic.
Unlock new kinds of magic as you level up, progress in the story, and even in the middle of combat.

-Level Cleared Adventure

Once you’ve cleared a level, you can replay it as many times as you want!
You can revisit the past by reviewing the story, and level up when you’re stuck in battle somewhere.

-Beautiful, moving events

Enjoy all of the many scenes showing off the characters’ living, breathing dialogue.
You can also skip over messages, set it to autoplay, and even remove the UI from the screen.
Dive into the scenes and live the game.

-An expansive world

This game is the sequel to HIBIKAKEYIRONOKISEKI, which has been downloaded more than a hundred thousand times!
It features an upgraded game system based on the previous game in the series.
Some characters from the previous game appear and you can see how their stories continue.
This game can be enjoyed without playing the previous game.

notes.title: Transfer of saved data from the trial version to the full version
notes.content:
You can transfer the saved data from the demo version to the full version.

Procedure
1) Right-click the demo version "Re:Kuroi Demo" in the Steam client and select "Manage" > "Browse Local Files".
If "Re:Kuroi Demo" is not displayed in the Steam client, open the "Re:Kuroi Demo" folder from the folder above the window opened in step 4 below.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40127500/7447e6235570e75ce02e0074c627912d0778573e.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40127500/ed719b2b2b9de8b5d2b1fd7b4d97965a334653cc.png[/img][/url]

2) Copy the "save" folder from the newly opened window.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40127500/0947dedac396212b616f4f4dc2ad6ecf6544d5e4.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40127500/0b77bdc66167d62f5795dbdd8a51ce4e442ba5f6.png[/img][/url]

3) Right-click on the Re:Kuroi demo in the Steam client and select "Manage" > "Browse Local Files".

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40127500/3c617e66d9415710fd1a7df7bffffede045215ae.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40127500/4bcaeff8668e1a5ed59c00fd6abf57c9cf92cba5.png[/img][/url]

4) Paste the "save" folder copied in step 2 into the newly opened window.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40127500/62e1b480a7e260ee64d8f379f49b0898f3e46310.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40127500/ba3288c18443c2ab546f153b826d9f6842d80375.png[/img][/url]

Notes
If you transfer the saved data that has cleared Act 5 in the demo version to the full version, you will be able to select Act 6.
There is no difference in the game content up to Act 5 between the demo version and the full version.

Translated with www.DeepL.com/Translator (free version)

notes.title: ver0.0.2 update
notes.content:
Ver. 0.0.2 is now available.

Additional functions
Added a list of state abnormalities to the Help list.
When a level up, magic flash, or both level up and magic flash occurs at the end of a battle, the text is now displayed, and a result previewing the changes before and after the battle is now displayed.

Other
Changed the magic flash staging.
The name focus display during events has been modified to display only when the speaker changes.
Fixed an issue where items other than the "Magic" command could be selected in the magic equipment tutorial that occurs in Act 2.
Fixed a bug that caused an error when clicking on an enemy during the period between the start of the battle and the display of the "Start Battle Menu" window.
Fixed a bug in which skipping an event with a choice open would leave the choice displayed.
Some other typos have been fixed.

Translated with www.DeepL.com/Translator (free version)

notes.title: The demo version of the game was released on April 15, 2021 (Japan time).
notes.content:
The demo version of the game was released on April 15, 2021 (Japan time).
The contents of the Demo version are as follows
You can play up to Act 5 stages.
The maximum character level is limited to 10.
The content of the demo version may differ from the full version to be released in the future.
We are looking for your feedback and suggestions.
We look forward to hearing from you.
